policy.natureDesc: Our services operate on a recurring subscription basis (monthly/yearly). Upon completing the payment, the subscriber immediately gains full access to the agreed digital services.
policy.noRefundDesc: Due to the digital nature of the service and its immediate availability for use, all payments collected for current subscription periods are non-refundable in whole or in part, and the subscriber is not entitled to claim a refund after service activation, in accordance with applicable laws governing digital goods and services.
policy.autoRenewDesc: The subscriber has the right to cancel the "Auto-Renewal" of the subscription at any time through their account dashboard.
policy.cancellationEffectDesc: Upon cancellation, the service will remain active until the end of the pre-paid subscription period. No new charges will be incurred in the future, and the subscription will terminate completely at the end of the current period.
policy.agreementDesc: By completing the payment process, the subscriber acknowledges that they have read and agreed to this policy and to waive their right to a refund for the current period once usage has begun.
